evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: NOT ASKED. Rep moved directly to logistics without asking about on-time reliability or damage concerns.

evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep mentioned 'Saturday tend to have a little bit more, more expensive hourly rate' and 'Sunday is cheaper than Saturday' but never offered the customer a dollar savings figure or asked about date flexibility. Only framed as hourly comparison, not total savings.

top_strength: Jules gathered exhaustive logistics detail (furniture list, addresses, property type, box count, washer/dryer consideration) with the customer's full engagement and no pressure, and personalized the estimate to the specific overnight logistics the move required.
coaching_note: Step 2 and Step 3 were completely skipped — Jules never asked about the customer's concerns (on-time guarantee, damage protection) and never delivered the Two Promises that answer them, moving straight to logistics instead; and Step 7 was never attempted — even when the customer was ready to book, Jules offered to send an email but never asked for the business directly or confirmed the Sunday 25th booking on the call.
